style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing and hairstyle. Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Water is a simple sculpted blue-gray sea surface. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered. Everything from the single year 1982; no extra props from other eras.
avoid_en: logos, brand names, readable text or numbers, flags, blood, wounds, faces resembling real people

sailor.desc_en: the sailor, a slim man around 30 as a miniature 3D figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short messy brown hair and a short brown beard, plain light gray T-shirt with no print, dark navy shorts, barefoot
